A plain notice, this week
A pleasant afternoon is easier with a plan
Travelers with pets should check the Companion Animal Travel Desk before heading to Aurelia Skyways check-in so the trip starts smoothly.

Bring your travel papers, keep carriers tidy, and make sure each animal is ready for the journey. The desk team can help with basic checks, crate guidance, and any small changes noted in the ledger. If you are flying with a bird, <<FACT F077>>. For a cat, <<FACT F067>>. That makes it easier to avoid delays and keeps everyone calm at the skyport.

Please arrive early enough to speak with staff, and keep your pet close while you wait. If you need support for a companion animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is the best place to begin.
